findings.title: Link/contact text from untrusted sources reaches the research surface; A2UI validator accepts it (W1-AC15/AC12)
D7 (quantities quoted verbatim) bypassed by quantity words the detector misses (tenfold, decade, percentage points, couple)
D10 pixel check passes text the user cannot read: white text covered by its own line-through bar reaches the Brain as 'pixel-checked'
URL query/fragment secrets and userinfo are not masked in either layer and reach the Brain (A0-AC7)
Brain slot not yielded to the user's turn; research cancel ignored during synthesis
Verifier keeps citations to sources that do not support the sentence
Assist answer/observation can be emitted after revoke
Dart Assist controller applies stale poll replies (answer shown while paused; a stale reply cancels a new ask)
Expired grant still shown as ACTIVE (prior R1-09 not fixed)
Vision path: page-text secrets not blacked out in the image; capture runs before gate checks; debounce set on refused attempts (vision disabled by default)
Research budget/cancel not checked in the search and feed loops (prior R1-08 not fixed)
NAT64 local-use prefix 64:ff9b:1::/48 judged only by its low 32 bits
IDN hosts can never be fetched (pinned host comparison uses httpx's decoded host)
AssistController used after dispose when an ask reply is in flight
Screenshot capture not bound to the granted target (prior R1-10 not fixed)
D10: covering under one cell of a text node (1-2 characters) passes and can change the meaning
R1-01 repair incomplete: link forms with zero-width space, title-case TLD, IDN host, soft hyphen or U+3002 pass the detector, verify(), the extractive path and the research surface
R1-02 repair incomplete: _in_order is a subsequence test, so a claim cut from one sentence restates a quantity in the Brain's own words, and the quantity-word list still misses common forms
R1-03 not repaired: white text covered by its own line-through bar reaches the Brain as pixel-checked
URL masking still passes some secret-bearing forms: ;jsessionid path parameter, ticket=, hmac=, oauth_verifier=
R2-01 repair still incomplete: title-case or mixed-case real gTLDs missing from the hard-coded _TLDS list pass the link detector, verify(), the extractive path and the research surface
R2-02 repair incomplete: _excerpt lets a claim drop a qualifier next to an undetected quantity word (doubling, halving, quintupled, biweekly), so a changed quantity is shown in the Brain's words
URL redaction ignores path matrix parameters and some token-bearing keys
R3-01 repair still incomplete: punycode (xn--) top-level domains are not links, so they pass has_link_or_contact, verify(), the extractive path and the research surface (W1-AC15/AC12)

R3-02 repair incomplete: _excerpt still lets a claim drop 'a <qualifier>' before an undetected quantity word (decennial, unanimous, quinquennial), so a changed quantity is shown unquoted in the Brain's words (D7)
A Chinese/Japanese host, then U+3002, then an IDN TLD not in _IDN_TLDS is not detected as a link (documented trade-off)

R1-01 class still open: a link next to an underscore or hyphen ('_refunds-portal.com_', 'refunds-portal.com_', '-refunds-portal.com') passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator

D7 bypass at the sentence edge: _excerpt lets a claim drop a leading qualifier ('Less than', 'Fewer than', 'Well short of') before an undetected quantity word (plurality, quintet, quorum), so a changed quantity is shown unquoted in the Brain's words

R1-01 class still open: a one-sided spaced dot ('refunds-portal .com/claim') or a dot-like separator (U+00B7, U+30FB, U+2219, U+22C5, U+2027, '{.}', '<.>') passes has_link_or_contact, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC15/AC12)

R5-02 repair incomplete: lead_ok/tail_ok treat a comma as a safe edge, so a claim drops a qualifier set off by commas ('that, at most, a quintet of firms...') before an undetected quantity word and is shown unquoted (D7)

R1-01 link class still open: a dot in a non-ASCII bracket/quote pair with spaces ('refunds-portal 【.】 com/claim', '「.」', '〔.〕', '«.»', '⟨.⟩', '"."'), a spaced dot run ('refunds-portal . . com/claim') or a So-category bullet ('◦' U+25E6, '●') passes has_link_or_contact, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC15/AC12, within D13 'any bracketed dot')
Verifier keeps a reversed-meaning claim in the Brain's words: an added or dropped determiner turns 'a little' into 'little' (and back), and the claim keeps its citation

R1-01 link class still open: letter-category middle-dot look-alikes (U+A78F LATIN LETTER SINOLOGICAL DOT, U+1427 CANADIAN SYLLABICS FINAL MIDDLE DOT) and a spaced dot before a split top-level label ('refunds-portal . c om/claim', 'refunds-portal . c o m') pass has_link_or_contact, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC15/AC12, D13 'middle dots', 'mask any dot-joined word')

R1-01 link class still open: spaced dot look-alikes U+2027 HYPHENATION POINT ('refunds-portal ‧ shop'), U+0660/U+06F0 Arabic-Indic zero ('refunds-portal ٠ com/claim') and U+4E36/U+2F02 dot stroke ('refunds-portal 丶 shop') pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D13 'with or without spaces')

R1-01 link class still open under D16: a separator gap longer than 12 characters (the R10-01 form repeated), a spaced core domain after a long prose gap, 'co m' splits, a Latin dot look-alike letter (U+0298) and a spaced punycode ending pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15)
A host that netpolicy accepts but httpx rejects (InvalidURL) is not caught by SafeFetcher and turns the whole research job into FAILED INTERNAL_ERROR, discarding every good source
A screenshot is captured before the vision gates (qualification, debounce, busy Brain slot) run
Race window: an assist.answer event with the full answer can be emitted after Stop (revoke)
Path parameters such as ';jsessionid=' are not masked in the page URL (both layers mask only after '?' or '#')
IDN and trailing-dot hosts can never be fetched: the pin compares the Unicode or dotted host with the IDNA host (fails closed)
The NAT64 local-use prefix 64:ff9b:1::/48 is decoded from the last 32 bits, and is_global is skipped

R1-01 link class still open under D16: a name in a different script from the ending (Cyrillic/Greek/Arabic name + core Latin domain, with a plain space or a path; Latin name + non-Latin listed TLD after a separator) passes has_link_or_contact, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15)

R12-01 repair regressed R11-01 and left a same-script variant open: two distinct dot-shaped letters ('丶丿', 'ㆍᆢ') or a doubled same-script look-alike ('ʘʘ') between name and a non-core TLD are read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D16)

R13-01 repair incomplete: two distinct CJK stroke/dot radicals between name and TLD ('丨丶', '一丶', '丶一', '乙丶', Kangxi '⼁⼂', '⼀⼂') are read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D17)

R1-01 link class still open: a foreign-script separator word of three or more distinct dot/stroke-shaped letters ('丶ㆍᆢ', '丶丿乀', '丨丶丿', 'ㆍᆢ丶') between name and a non-core TLD is read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D16)

netpolicy accepts 64:ff9b:1::/48 (RFC 8215 local-use NAT64) addresses embedding a private IPv4 at the /48, /56 or /64 offsets: _embedded_v4 always reads the last 32 bits and the NAT64 branch returns before the is_global check (W1-AC1)

Split ending whose first piece is a common two-letter word is not joined even after a non-prose separator ('refunds-portal ~ go ld/claim', '~ he lp') - the disclosed, not owner-accepted, limitation is wider than needed
SearxngProvider does not catch httpx.InvalidURL: an owner-configured SearXNG URL with an invalid IDNA host turns the research job into FAILED INTERNAL_ERROR (R11-02 pattern in search)
Assist answer stored and emitted after Stop: the ask thread re-checks the grant before, not under the lock with, storing and emitting the answer (A0-AC4 race)

Vision path: screenshot captured before VisionGate refusals (not qualified, busy, debounced); 'screenshot for this question' toggle persists across asks, Stop and new grants; prepare_image does not check screenshot size against viewport x DPR before masking field rectangles

R16-01/D19 repair incomplete: stroke- and dot-shaped letters missing from the hard-coded _STROKES list (Hangul ㅡ/ㅣ, katakana ノ, 丷, 三) form a 3-letter separator word that is read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D19)

R17-01/D19 repair incomplete: stroke-shaped kana missing from _STROKES (katakana ニ/ハ/ト look the same as listed 二/八/卜; full-size ハ/ヘ/レ while small ㇵ/ㇸ/ㇾ are listed; フ, hiragana く/し/へ) form a separator word that is read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D19)

R1-01 link class still open: a run of three or more distinct combining dot marks on a space ('refunds-portal ̣̇̈ shop') is read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D13/D16)

D16 ending check ignores the skeleton: a core domain written in Cyrillic look-alikes after a plain space ('refunds-portal сом', 'refunds-portal іо') is not a link, although 'portal com' is (W1-AC12/AC15)
Disclosed, not owner-accepted: a split ending whose first piece is in _COMMON2 is never joined ('refunds-portal 丶丿 go ld', '... on line')

R19-01 repair incomplete: a separator word plus a combining mark ('丶丿̣', 'ᆞᆢ̣', 'ニハト̣', 'ʘ̣') is read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive() and the research surface (W1-AC12/AC15, D17/D19)

R19-02 repair incomplete: a look-alike core domain spelt with spaces ('refunds-portal с о м', 'со м') is not an ending, although Latin 'c o m' / 'co m' are links; with a path, masking still leaves 'refunds-portal с о' on screen

R20-01 repair regressed R19-01: a run of three or more non-'COMBINING'-named marks on a space (Devanagari nukta/candrabindu/anusvara, Tibetan, Arabic, Thai, Telugu signs) between name and a non-core TLD is read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D13/D16)

R1-01 link class still open (R19-01/R20-01/R21-01 family): script marks on a carrier letter are not removed before separator classification, so 'refunds-portal ـِٜٕ shop' (tatweel + 3 distinct Arabic marks) passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator; a separator letter/word plus one non-'COMBINING' mark ('x़', 'ʘ़', '丶丿़') is detected but mask_links leaves 'refunds-portal [link removed] shop' on screen (W1-AC12/AC15, D13/D16/D17)

R22-01 repair incomplete (R19/R20/R21/R22 family): a single foreign letter plus two or more marks of its own script ('بِٜ', 'क़ँं', 'กั่์') between name and a non-core TLD is read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D17)

R1-01 link class still open (D16 ending side): a listed non-Latin top-level domain written with optional same-script vowel marks (Arabic harakat 'مِصْر', 'عُمان', 'السُّعُودِيَّة', 'ایرانْ', 'شَبَكة'; Hebrew niqqud 'קוֹם') is not an ending, so 'refunds-portal ~ مِصْر' passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive() and the research surface (W1-AC12/AC15)

R24-01 repair incomplete: Arabic vowel marks and Quranic marks missing from the hard-coded _VOWELS ranges (U+0618-061A ARABIC SMALL FATHA/DAMMA/KASRA, U+0610-0617 honorific signs, U+08D3-08FF Extended-A marks such as OPEN FATHATAN and CURLY FATHA) keep a listed Arabic top-level domain from matching, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15)

R24-01/R25-01 class still open: a listed top-level domain with a diacritic that NFKC composes into a precomposed letter ('ćom' -> 'ćom', 'òrg', 'ṣhop' -> 'ṣhop', 'shóp', 'cásh', Cyrillic 'е́ф') is not an ending, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D16)

R1-01 link class still open (D16 ending side, R19-02 class in Latin): a core or listed top-level domain written with Latin look-alike letters ('ɡov' U+0261 script g, small capitals 'ᴄᴏᴍ', 'cøm', 'ȼom', 'ƈom', 'sħop') is not an ending, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive() and the research surface (W1-AC12/AC15)

R27-01 repair incomplete: Latin look-alike letters whose Unicode name has no A-Z letter (U+0251 LATIN SMALL LETTER ALPHA 'ɑ', U+0269 LATIN SMALL LETTER IOTA 'ɩ', U+0196 'Ɩ') are not folded, so 'refunds-portal bɩz/claim' (core domain, plain space), 'refunds-portal ɩo/claim', 'refunds-portal ~ cɑsh', '~ ɑpp' and '~ ɩnfo' pass has_link_or_contact and mask_links; the probed '~ cɑsh', 'cɑsh/claim', '~ ɩnfo', '~ ɑpp' and 'ɑpp/claim' forms also pass verify(), extractive() and the research surface (W1-AC12/AC15, D16)

R28-01 repair incomplete (R1-01/R19-02/R27-01 class): the skeleton fallback added for Latin letters uses the 58-character hand-made _CONFUSABLE table, which holds no Latin letters and misses common Cyrillic/Greek look-alikes, so endings spelt 'ѕһор' (Cyrillic shha U+04BB), 'miǀ' (U+01C0 dental click as l), 'coʍ' (U+028D turned w read as 'w') or 'ϲοΜ' (U+03F2) are not links and pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D16)

R29-01 repair incomplete (R1-01/R19-02/R27-01 class): the confusables data keeps only ASCII prototypes, so Cyrillic look-alikes whose prototype is a non-ASCII Latin letter (ћ~ħ, ҫ~ç, ө/ѳ~ɵ, ӎ~ɱ) have no fold and endings 'ѕћор', 'ҫом', 'сөм', 'соӎ', 'ѕһөр' are not links; they pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D16)

R1-01 link class still open: ASCII look-alikes listed in the Unicode confusables data (digit 0 ~ O, 1/I/| ~ l) are not folded, so 'refunds-portal.c0m/claim' (real dot), '.g0v', '.0rg', '.mi1', '.b1z', 'refunds-portal . c0m', 'refunds-portal [.] c0m', 'refunds-portal c0m/claim', 'refunds-portal ~ g0v' and 'refunds-portal miI/claim' pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D13/D16/D29)
mask_links masks only the ending, not the name, for an ending spelt with a symbol inside ('refunds-portal c○m' -> 'refunds-portal [link removed]')

R31-01 repair incomplete: _ascii_variant folds look-alikes only in runs with at least two letters, so two-character endings with one ASCII look-alike ('refunds-portal.i0/claim' = .io core domain, '.c0', '.t0', '.1y', '.m0', '.|y', 'refunds-portal i0/claim', '~ i0', ' . i0') pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D13/D16/D29)

R31-01/R32-01 class still open: a leading capital 'I' look-alike of 'l' is never folded, so endings 'Iy', 'Ia', 'Ii', 'Iu', 'Iv', 'Ik', 'Iol', 'Iive', 'Iink', 'Iat', 'Iaw', 'Iand', 'Iife', 'Ioan' after a separator ('refunds-portal ~ Iy') pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive() and the research surface, while the 'l' spellings are links (W1-AC12/AC15, D16/D29)

R33-01 repair incomplete (R31/R32/R33 class): capital 'I' as 'l' is not folded in upper-case runs, and the leading-I step makes the general fold turn the next 'I' into 'l', so 'IIVE', 'IINK', 'IOI', 'PI', 'II' and core 'MII/claim' pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive() and the research surface while 'lIVE', 'lINK', 'lOl', 'Pl', 'Il', 'MIl/claim' are links (W1-AC12/AC15, D16/D29)

R33-01/R34-01 class still open: after '. ', ': ', '! ' or '? ' a leading capital 'I' look-alike of 'l' is never folded (sentence-start exemption), so 'refunds-portal. Iive', 'refunds-portal. Iy', 'refunds-portal: Iink/claim', 'refunds-portal? Iy/claim', 'refunds-portal! Ioan/claim' pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator, while the 'l' spellings are links (W1-AC12/AC15, D13/D16/D29)

R31-01/D29 class still open: a top-level domain spelt only with ASCII look-alikes that include '|' ('refunds-portal.|0|/claim' = .lol, '.0||0' = .ollo) is never folded because _ascii_variant needs an alphabetic character in the run, so it passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15)

R1-01/R31-01 class still open: an ending mixing confusables-listed Cyrillic look-alikes with an ASCII look-alike ('с0м', 'ӏ0ӏ', '|оІ', 'ѕ|') is folded by neither the skeleton nor _ascii_variant, so it passes has_link_or_contact, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D16/D29)

R1-01/R31-01 class still open: a spaced-out ending with an ASCII look-alike digit ('c 0 m', 'g 0 v', 'i 0', Cyrillic 'с 0 м') is not a link, although 'c o m' is; it passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive() and the research surface (W1-AC12/AC15, D16/D29)

R37-01 repair incomplete: a mixed Cyrillic/ASCII look-alike ending followed by an underscore ('refunds-portal ~ с0м_') is not folded, so it passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive() and the research surface, while 'с0м', 'c0m_' and 'сом_' are links (W1-AC12/AC15)

R38-01 repair incomplete (R1-01/R31-01 class): _SPELT_SINGLES reads only single characters separated by single plain spaces, so partially spelt or differently spaced endings with an ASCII look-alike digit ('g0 v', 'g 0v', '0r g', '0 rg', 'c  0  m', '(c 0 m)', 'c\t0\tm', 'i  0') are not links, although the letter forms ('go v', 'g ov', 'or g', 'c  o  m', '(c o m)', 'c\to\tm', 'i  o') are; they pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D16/D29)

R39-01 repair incomplete (R1-01/R31-01 class): _digit_variant folds a look-alike digit only in a token with a letter or a one-character token, so a spelt ending whose last digit touches punctuation ('(refunds-portal i 0)', '~ i 0,', '~ i 0.', '~ i 0;', '~ i 0:', "~ 't 0'") is not a link while the letter forms are; it passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15, D16/D29)

Answer derived before Pause/Stop is shown after it: the poll reply in flight is applied without an ask-id/epoch check; the worker can still emit assist.answer after revoke (A0-AC4/AC5, R9-05 contract)
Withheld field values (OTP, plain contenteditable) reach the Brain through 'Headings (pixel-checked)': headings have no in-field filter in snapshot.js or perception (A0-AC7, D8)

Secrets in URLs written in visible page text or a shared contenteditable (client_secret=, refresh_token=, otp=, pin=, session_id=, userinfo) are not masked and reach the Brain, although the same keys are masked in the Location line (A0-AC7)
Instruction-like page titles, search snippets and feed titles are not flagged; the title reaches the Brain unfiltered, and a trusted NO_ANSWER lets a source suppress a supported answer (W1-AC12)
Sensitive fields inside shadow roots and iframes are never listed, so the vision screenshot does not black them out (latent: vision off by default, channel not built; undocumented)
In-page/Python parity: a contenteditable's name attribute and role=searchbox are judged differently, so the in-page layer lets a value leave the page (Python withholds it)
Target labels and origins are returned unredacted by assist_targets, assist_status and assist_diagnostics (A0-AC7 wording; local UI only, never sent to the Brain)
Citation label shows a second domain, e-mail, phone or IP held in the URL path (documented host/path design; the attacker can already be the cited host)
Surface lists only sources[:10] and conflicts[:3] while Budget.clamp allows 12 pages: an answer can cite [11]/[12] that is not listed (latent: the worker uses the default 6)
The surface's own header line is link-masked ('1 [link removed]: extractive · 1.234 [link removed] ...') on every result
Verifier ignores sentence punctuation: a cited statement can be turned into a question or put in scare quotes and is shown as supported Brain wording
SafeFetcher refuses every IDN host and every host with a trailing dot (PIN_HOST_MISMATCH reported as UNREACHABLE); bare IPv6 Host header lacks brackets (fail closed, not SSRF)
Observation stamp does not bind the content hash; negative age (clock going back or future captured_at) passes check_fresh (A0-AC6 wording; not reachable with monotonic clock)

R41-03 repair incomplete: URL secrets split across inline elements (e.g. ?client_secret=VALUE, highlighted client_secret=VALUE, https://user:PW@host) are not masked in page text or headings and reach the Brain, while the selection path masks the same URL (A0-AC7)

R1-01/R38-R40 link class still open: a spelt-out ending that starts with (or contains) a Cyrillic/Greek look-alike letter mixed with Latin letters ('refunds-portal ~ о r g/claim', '~ е d u/claim', '~ і o/claim', '~ о  r  g') is not a link and passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator; detected forms ('(refunds-portal i о)', '~ g о v/claim') are masked without the name (W1-AC12/AC15, D16/D29)
R42-01 residual: a URL secret split across two or more inline-block boxes reaches the Brain; the whitespace fail-closed rule masks only the next single token (A0-AC7)

D31 acceptance stress test is fully blocked only for its fixed seeds (7, 11, 23); the same generator with other seeds yields disguised endings that pass has_link_or_contact, verify() and the research surface

In-page (snapshot.js) layer does not mask a URL secret whose key and value are in different layout blocks (flex item, inline-block, inline-flex, table cell, button); only the Python layer masks it (JS/Python parity)
